info.name: List disk snapshots of a Devbox.

params.name: devbox_id
params.description: Devbox ID to filter by.

params.name: source_blueprint_id
params.description: Source Blueprint ID to filter snapshots by.

params.name: metadata[key]
params.description: Filter snapshots by metadata key-value pair. Can be used multiple times for different keys.

params.name: metadata[key][in]
params.description: Filter snapshots by metadata key with multiple possible values (OR condition).

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of items to return. Default is 20. Max is 5000.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Load the next page of data starting after the item with the given ID.

params.name: include_total_count
params.description: If true (default), includes total_count in the response. Set to false to skip the count query for better performance on large datasets.

items.docs: List all snapshots of a Devbox while optionally filtering by Devbox ID, source Blueprint ID, and metadata.

params.name: devbox_id
params.description: Devbox ID to filter by.

params.name: source_blueprint_id
params.description: Source Blueprint ID to filter snapshots by.

params.name: metadata[key]
params.description: Filter snapshots by metadata key-value pair. Can be used multiple times for different keys.

params.name: metadata[key][in]
params.description: Filter snapshots by metadata key with multiple possible values (OR condition).

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of items to return. Default is 20. Max is 5000.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Load the next page of data starting after the item with the given ID.

params.name: include_total_count

items.docs: List all public disk snapshots that are available to all users.
Returns a list of all available metadata keys that can be used for filtering snapshots.

info.name: List values for a specific snapshot metadata key.

params.name: key
params.description: The metadata key to get values for.

items.docs: Returns a list of all values that exist for a specific metadata key across all snapshots.

info.name: List available public snapshot metadata keys.

items.docs: Returns a list of all available metadata keys from public snapshots only that can be used for filtering.

info.name: List values for a specific public snapshot metadata key.

params.name: key
params.description: The metadata key to get values for from public snapshots.

items.docs: Returns a list of all values that exist for a specific metadata key across all public snapshots only.

params.name: id
params.description: The Snapshot ID.

items.docs: Updates disk snapshot metadata via update vs patch. The entire metadata will be replaced.

info.name: Delete a disk snapshot of a Devbox.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the snapshot.

items.docs: Delete a previously taken disk snapshot of a Devbox.

info.name: Query the status of an asynchronous disk snapshot.

params.name: id
params.description: The Snapshot ID.

items.docs: Get the current status of an asynchronous disk snapshot operation, including whether it is still in progress and any error messages if it failed.

info.name: Synchronously create a disk snapshot of a running Devbox.

params.name: id
params.description: The Devbox ID.

items.docs: Create a disk snapshot of a devbox with the specified name and metadata to enable launching future Devboxes with the same disk state.

info.name: Start an asynchronous disk snapshot of a running Devbox.

params.name: id
params.description: The Devbox ID.

items.docs: Start an asynchronous disk snapshot of a devbox with the specified name and metadata. The snapshot operation will continue in the background and can be monitored using the query endpoint.
